notes.title: Steam Keys for Early Purchasers in The Wld
notes.content:
If you got the game through Humble or a bundle that gave you Desura keys, you should have access to a Steam Key now.

If you're old school and purchased the game directly from me back in the day, I'm working on getting you keys through e-mail soon.

If you have problems getting a key check out the community hub for a discussion on the topic with a couple workarounds for hiccups.

notes.title: POP: Methodology Experiment One Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
"So Rob, what is this junk?"

Well it's everything in one nice package. The deluxe version includes:

[list]
[*] POP: Methodology Experiment One
[*] POP: Methodology Experiment One - Game of the Saeculum Edition DLC 
[*] POP: Methodology Experiment One - DLC
[/list]
